notes: First launch now walks you through adding your API key and picking a role.
Eight conversation partners: classmate, teacher, friend, roommate, colleague, interviewer, doctor and waiter.
Each role ships with 50 built-in situations — tap Surprise me to draw six fresh ones.
Failures are reported as they are. An invalid key or a network problem is shown instead of a canned reply.
The API key field is plain text, so it stays visible on phones.
